violations.text: The reach-in cooler at the server station was observed holding an ambient temperature of 46 degrees Fahrenheit. The back of the unit was observed with heavy ice accumulation (NO TCS Foods at time of inspection). Call was made for refrigeration service at the time of inspection. Technician arrived by end of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
The doors to the toilet rooms are not self-closing. Door self-closing mechanisms to be added. New Violation. Correct By: 07/06/2026
